archetypes.name: dyn-awk-parser
archetypes.rationale: The awk scanner now tokenizes shell-like syntax and option/value pairs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed awk scanner in scripts/lint-bare-grep-probe.sh. Focus on candidate normalization, quote handling, stdin /dev/null detection, and argv truncation. Check whether common shell shapes can be false-allowed or noisy false positives under the line-based model. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The behavior is documented across authoring guidance, linter docs, and linting docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed docs and harness contract against the linter behavior. Focus on whether BASH_AUTHORING.md, scripts/lint-bare-grep-probe.md, scripts/test-lint-bare-grep-probe.md, and docs/linting.md describe the same path-or-/dev/null rule and wrapper-trap exception boundaries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
